title: Quartet
program_note:
This Quartet was begun in February, 1992, and completed in July, 1992.  In form, if not in style, it is meant to be a “classical” work, in three movements.  It begins with a brisk Rondo, continues in a more reflective Romanza Rubato, and concludes wiht a quirky two-tempoed Scherzo-Finale.  The total duration of the work is approximately fifteen minutes, broken down as follows:  5:00, 4:45, 5:00.

David S. Lefkowitz

9 July, 1992

Rochester, NY
